title: Help.
content: I wonder if anyone else out here experiences this, where you dream most nights, very vivid and emotionally impactful dreams. I’m so lost. I’ve been put on so many different SSRIs and PTSD medication, but none have calmed the dreams . I haven’t had a consistent good night of sleep for five years. The dreams are nonspecific and very night to night, sometimes even four different places ventured in a night. I wake up constantly in night sweats, freezing. It’s ruining my life and mental health as it’s getting hard to discern dreams from reality and certainly waking up nightly , cold and soaking wet does not help. Does anyone else experience this? They are trying to put me on a sleep apnea machine, but I tested so low I don’t believe it matches with my very severe symptoms . Dreaming is great, I have visited much of mall world but it’s hurting my mental health so much having this very real experience in an alternate reality
